verdict.rationale:
Insomnia ships narrow AI-powered features—generating mock servers from natural-language prompts and suggesting Git commit messages—but there's no evidence of a general-purpose built-in AI assistant that can be delegated broader tasks (e.g., writing tests, debugging requests, chat-based help) across the product. This falls short of a true 'AI assistant' delegation model described in the story.
missing for 10: evidence of a conversational/agentic assistant beyond mock-gen and commit messages, ability to delegate arbitrary API-testing tasks, independent hands-on validation of the AI features' usefulness.
